text:
Predicates:
Season(x) ::: x is a season.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
FavoriteSeason(x, y) ::: x's favorite season is y.
WantLongVacation(x) ::: x wants to have a long vacation.
LoveMost(x, y) ::: x loves y the most.

Premises:
∀x (Season(x) ↔ (x = spring ∨ x = summer ∨ x = fall ∨ x = winter)) ::: There are four seasons in a year: Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WantLongVacation(x) → LoveMost(x, summer)) ::: All students who want to have a long vacation love summer the most.
FavoriteSeason(emma, summer) ::: Emma's favorite season is summer.
¬(FavoriteSeason(mia, summer)) ::: Mia's favorite season is not the same as Emma's.
Student(james) ∧ WantLongVacation(james) ::: James wants to have a long vacation.

Conclusion:
FavoriteSeason(james, summer) ::: James's favorite season is summer.
